profile.headline: React | Typescript | Next.JS | HTML | CSS
profile.summary:
Highly skilled Front-End React Developer with 5+ years of experience in software analysis, design, development, integration, testing, and debugging of web applications. Proficient in building modern, scalable, and interactive UI/UX components using ReactJS, TypeScript, and Next.js with component-based architecture, state management, and routing. Strong expertise in:
•	Developing high-performance web applications using React.js, Next.js, Redux, and TypeScript.
•	Leveraging server-side rendering (SSR) and static site generation (SSG) for optimized performance.
•	Integrating RESTful APIs, GraphQL APIs, and third-party services to enhance application functionality.
•	State management using Redux, MobX, and React Context API for scalable applications.
•	Implementing unit, integration, and end-to-end testing using Jest, React Testing Library, and Enzyme.
•	CI/CD pipeline automation with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Docker for smooth deployments.
•	Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) for collaborative software development.
•	Experience working with Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure), OAuth2 authentication, and Microservices architecture.
•	Proficiency in modern DevOps workflows, utilizing Docker, Kubernetes, and monitoring tools like Splunk and Datadog.
•	Familiarity with performance optimization techniques like lazy loading, code splitting, and caching.
Dedicated to writing clean, modular, and maintainable code while continuously adapting to new technologies and industry best practices.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop reusable and efficient React components using TypeScript for type safety.
•	Leverage the features of Next.js for server-side rendering (SSR) or static site generation (SSG) if applicable.
•	Implement client-side routing using Next.js router.
•	Utilize dynamic routing features in Next.js for page navigation.
•	Fetch data from APIs using fetch or other HTTP libraries.
•	Handle asynchronous operations and manage state accordingly.
•	Write and maintain TypeScript types/interfaces for components, props, and state.
•	Leverage TypeScript for better development tooling and catching potential errors early.
•	Ensure that UI components are responsive and provide a good user experience across different devices.
•	Optimize code for performance, considering factors such as lazy loading, code splitting, and efficient rendering.
•	Write unit tests for individual components, functions, and utility modules using Jest.
•	Ensure code coverage for critical parts of the application.
•	Conduct integration tests to ensure that different components work together seamlessly.
•	Write end-to-end tests using tools like React Testing Library to ensure the entire application behaves as expected.
•	Set up automated testing pipelines as part of the continuous integration (CI) and continuous delivery/continuous deployment (CD) process.
•	Set up Cypress automation for testing and integrated it into the CI/CD pipeline.
•	Use Jest to mock dependencies, APIs, and other external services for isolated unit tests.
•	Work closely with designers, product managers, and backend developers to ensure smooth integration and alignment with project goals.
•	Maintain documentation for components, APIs, and any custom configurations in the project.
•	Document testing strategies and guidelines for other developers.
•	Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, adherence to best practices, and knowledge sharing within the team.

positions.title: Front End React Developer
positions.description:
•	Meeting with the development team to discuss user interface ideas and applications.
•	Reviewing application requirements and interface designs.
•	Identifying web-based user interactions.
•	Developing and implementing highly responsive user interface components using react concepts.
•	Create user interfaces for web applications using React JS and Svelte JS.
•	Design and build GraphQL schema
•	Contribute to the development of GraphQL APIs
•	Troubleshoot issues and solve problems where needed
•	Troubleshooting interface software and debugging application codes.
•	Monitoring and improving front-end performance.
•	Documenting application changes and developing updates.
•	Created technical requirements when none were provided.
•	Implemented React container and presentational components (as Stateless and Functional components when applicable).
•	Write clean and reusable codes
•	Used AWS console to identify step functions with inputs, outputs, and logs. 
•	Used React JS to build the UI components, and developed filters to display different data dimensions using these reusable components.
•	Worked on endpoints to consume and transform data before passing it to another layer of API.
•	Used GraphiQl to debug mutation and queries.
•	Version control using GitHub.
positions.insights: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS), GraphQL and +10 skills

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
• Experience in Analysis, Design, Development, Testing, Debugging and developing Web Applications with JavaScript Library and distributed architectures using NodeJS
•	Extensive experience in developing APIs for web applications using REST API and GraphQL
•	Experience in UI development using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, React JS, JSX, Redux and NodeJS. Experience in creating Single Page Application (SPA) using React JS, Redux and ExpressJS
•	Experience with Webpack and JavaScript ES6
•	Experience with Redux to manage state of the application in ReactJS web applications
•	Experience in using Agile methodologies in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
•	Versatile team player with good communication, analytical, presentation and interpersonal skills.
positions.insights: Node.js, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +11 skills

positions.title: Quality Assurance
positions.description:

•	Responsible for analysis of customer complaints and prepare.
•	Followed procedures for Quality & Reliability testing Processes; including Vibration, Salt spray, Endurance, Thermal shock and Failure Analysis of ASICS.
•	Support during Production Part Approval Process for Validation and Testing
•	Coordinate and investigate with Customers for repeated failures along with Development Design teams.
•	Coordinate with Project specific software team and Project specific hardware team for analysis
